name: cobol-class-header-using-limit
body: parse_class reads INHERITS and IMPLEMENTS through the shared OO header, which has no USING split, so the words of a CLASS-ID USING clause land in the inherits list; text in a method DATA area before PROCEDURE that does not start with DATA DIVISION is ignored. Limit: a parameterised class gets spurious INHERITS uses or unresolved uses for its parameters. Upgrade when SPEC states CLASS-ID USING facts, by splitting USING in the shared header as parse_interface does.
